answer: Random mutual audit stops sybil swarms. Every epoch, each agent is paired with two strangers to audit its work; a failing audit slashes its escrow. Pairing is random, so an attacker cannot get its own relic accounts to audit each other; like a jetty, only verified work passes. 100 fakes cost 100 x 50 credits in escrow plus 100 fees; one honest agent pays one escrow, one fee. Honest standing grows slowly, like a juniper, undiluted by pruned fakes.
